info.name: INFLX Phase 5 — Crons, Analytics & Payouts
info.description: Phase 5 endpoints: Cron job triggers, Engagement Analytics, Admin Escrow Management, Influencer Withdrawal, Updated Earnings

item.name: Cron Jobs (Manual Test Triggers)
item.description: These are server-side cron jobs. In production they run on schedule. For manual testing, use the curl commands below or call run() directly in tests.

request.description:
This cron runs at 00:01 IST.

What it does:
- Finds follower_transactions where return_window_ends_at <= NOW() AND commission_confirmed_at IS NULL AND status = 'completed'
- Moves influencer_commission from pending_balance → wallet_balance
- Fires in-app notification: '₹X commission confirmed — available to withdraw'

Manual trigger (test env):
  const { run } = require('./src/jobs/commission-confirm.job');
  await run();

curl test:
  No HTTP endpoint — run via Jest test: npm test -- --testPathPattern=cron-commission-confirm

This cron runs at 06:00 UTC.

What it does:
- Finds escrow_entries with trigger_event='day_30_post_live', status='queued', triggered_at <= NOW() - 30 days
- Calls processTrancheReleaseStandalone(escrowEntryId)
- Marks campaign_influencer and campaign as completed if all tranches released
- Notifies influencer (push + SMS) and brand (push)

curl test: npm test -- --testPathPattern=cron-tranche3

This cron runs at 06:00 UTC (alongside tranche-3).

What it does:
- Finds all live deliverables with a live_url
- Calls apifyService.scrapePostEngagement(live_url) for each
- Upserts deliverable_stats row with reach, impressions, likes, comments, saves, shares, engagement_rate

curl test: npm test -- --testPathPattern=engagement

This cron runs at 00:05 UTC.

What it does:
- Finds campaigns with end_date < TODAY AND status IN ('live','active','published')
- If all campaign_influencers are completed AND all escrow released → marks campaign completed
- Logs warning for stale campaigns with pending tranches

curl test: npm test -- --testPathPattern=cron-campaign-status

This cron runs at 01:00 UTC (≈ 06:30 IST).

What it does:
- Finds follower_bookings with booking_date = TODAY AND status = 'confirmed'
- Sends push + SMS to follower: 'Reminder: Your booking at [brand] is today. Ref: [code]'

curl test: Direct DB insert + run() call in test

This cron runs at 09:00 UTC.

What it does:
- For brands with active campaigns, finds highest queued escrow tranche
- If brand.wallet_balance < highest_tranche → fires push + SMS + in-app alert

curl test: npm test -- --testPathPattern=cron-low-wallet

Returns full engagement analytics for a brand's campaign.

Auth: Brand JWT required

Response includes:
- campaign_id, campaign_name, date_range
- totals: total_reach, total_impressions, blended_er, category_benchmark_er (hardcoded 3.8)
- daily_reach: array of { date, reach } (from deliverable_stats.scraped_at)
- by_influencer: array with per-influencer reach, likes, comments, saves, shares, engagement_rate, deliverables[]

Note: daily_reach generates 12 mock days when APIFY_MOCK=true and no real data exists

Returns all escrow_entries across all campaigns.

Auth: Admin JWT required (finance or superadmin)
Query params: ?status=queued|locked|released|all (default: all)

Each entry includes: campaign_name, influencer_name, brand_name, tranche_number, amount, net_to_influencer, escrow_fee_amount, status, trigger_event, triggered_at, released_at, razorpay_payout_id

Manually releases a queued or locked escrow tranche.

Auth: Admin JWT required (finance or superadmin ONLY — reviewer gets 403)

Body: { override_reason: string (required) }

Use case: brand dispute resolved, manual T3 trigger, admin override
Action: calls processTrancheReleaseStandalone(), credits influencer wallet, logs override reason

Returns platform-wide statistics.

Auth: Any admin JWT (reviewer, finance, or superadmin)

Response:
- pending_approvals: { brands, influencers }
- active_brands, active_influencers, active_campaigns
- platform_revenue_this_month (follower platform fees + released escrow fees for current month)
- total_follower_transactions, total_commission_paid
- escrow_locked, escrow_queued
- stats: { ... } (Phase 1 backward-compatible wrapper)

Initiates a withdrawal for the authenticated influencer.

Auth: Influencer JWT required

Validations:
- amount_requested >= 10000 paise (₹100 minimum) — WITHDRAWAL_TOO_SMALL
- amount_requested <= wallet_balance — INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
- Influencer must have UPI or bank account — PAYMENT_METHOD_MISSING

TDS calculation:
  tds_deducted = floor(amount_requested × 0.10)
  net_paid = amount_requested - tds_deducted

When RAZORPAY_MOCK=true: status='completed' immediately
When RAZORPAY_MOCK=false: status='processing', webhook updates to completed/failed

Side effects:
- Deducts amount_requested from wallet_balance immediately
- Creates influencer_withdrawals row
- Fires push + SMS notification

Returns all past withdrawals for the authenticated influencer.

Auth: Influencer JWT required

Each row: withdrawal_id, amount_requested, tds_deducted, net_paid, method, status, created_at, completed_at

Sorted by created_at DESC

Retries a failed withdrawal.

Auth: Influencer JWT required

Only works when withdrawal.status = 'failed'.
Action:
- Refunds amount_requested back to wallet_balance
- Resets withdrawal to 'initiated'
- Re-initiates payout (RAZORPAY_MOCK=true → always succeeds)

Returns full earnings picture for the authenticated influencer.

Auth: Influencer JWT required

Phase 5 additions:
- available_to_withdraw: same as wallet_balance (UI clarity)
- recent_withdrawals: last 5 withdrawals with tds breakdown
- tds_this_financial_year: sum of tds_deducted from April 1 of current Indian FY (April 1 – March 31)

Full response shape:
{
  wallet_balance, pending_balance, total_earned,
  available_to_withdraw,
  pending_amount, locked_entries,
  commission_summary: { pending, confirmed, total },
  recent_withdrawals: [ { withdrawal_id, amount_requested, net_paid, tds_deducted, method, status, created_at } ],
  tds_this_financial_year
}
